g.text: Within-period predictions • matched examples per setting • five sampling seeds • frozen models use P3
Top: mean risk with ±1 sample SD. Bottom: numbers inside markers are retained error percentages; ranks describe means only.
Coverage sweep: 20–100%. Tied confidence scores use expected risk under uniform random tie-breaking; P5 abstention is excluded.
n is examples per class. Each model may retain different cases. Small rank differences do not establish a statistically reliable ordering.
